extracted.name: Cream Cheese Tart Shells
extracted.description: A mini tart shell recipe for any filling. These dainty pastry shells made with cream cheese, butter, and flour, will go with just about anything.
instruction_lines: Blend butter and cream cheese. Stir in flour just until blended. Chill about 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).
Shape dough into 24 1-inch balls and press into ungreased 1 1/2-inch muffin cups (mini-muffin size) to make a shallow shell.
Fill with your favorite filling and bake until shells are light brown, about 20 minutes.
